summary: Inventory tips: use meaningful, unique, case-sensitive group names without spaces, hyphens or leading numbers (floor_19 not 19th_floor), and group hosts by what (db, web), where (region, data center) and when (dev, prod).
questions: What are best practices for Ansible inventory group names?
Can Ansible group names contain hyphens?
How should I organize hosts into groups?
Are inventory group names case sensitive?
